question: What golden figure should be deposited in the locus of the peak syllable?
premises: A figure must be fashioned from gold.
The placement locus is the kūṭa syllable.
inference: One should fashion a golden bull and deposit it in the locus of the peak syllable.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the kūṭākṣara is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Having made a bull of gold, one should deposit it in the locus of the peak syllable.
